blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱341.27 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱10 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 22-43-34-12-06-27, with a jackpot of ₱341.27 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers. The Lotto 6/42 draw produced the winning combination 18-33-28-23-19-04 for a ₱10 million jackpot. No bettor won the top prize.
